# N34: Fields switched off: no Fields block on a goal, no Workspace → Fields, no Stage filter on Goals or column on Data, its address says it is off, and it all comes back on

A check of the Fields module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/34-fields-off.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

Fields switched off (TG1, docs/design/round-4/tags/spec.md section 6). run({ open, url }) returns a list of failures. As Amara, an admin, on a computer: with a field “Stage” added, a goal's page shows its Fields block and Workspace's menu has Fields; Goals' Filters sheet has a Stage row and Data's Goals table a Stage column (TG2). Switched off on Workspace, Features: the goal's page has no Fields block, Workspace's menu has no Fields, /workspace/fields is Page not found saying Fields is switched off, Goals has no Stage filter and Data no Stage column, and Help has no Fields article. Switched back on, they are back, the field with them. The AI tools' refusals, find_goals' fields filter among them, and the export's and import's columns are unit tests (src/modules/tags/tools.test.ts, sheet.test.ts).

## Where it looks

- 1440 × 900, as amara, at `/workspace/fields`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.

## What it reports as wrong

- the field “Stage” was not added
- with Fields on, a goal’s page has no Fields block
- with Fields on, Workspace’s menu has no Fields
- with Fields on, Goals’ Filters sheet has no Stage row
- with Fields on, Data’s Goals table has no Stage column
- with Fields off, a goal’s page still has a Fields block
- with Fields off, Workspace’s menu still has Fields
- /workspace/fields is not Page not found with Fields off
- /workspace/fields does not say Fields is switched off
- with Fields off, Goals’ Filters sheet still has a Stage row
- with Fields off, Data’s Goals table still has a Stage column
- with Fields off, Goals does not list every goal
- Help still lists the Fields article
- Fields back on, a goal’s page has no Fields block
- Fields back on, the block does not show Stage
- Fields back on, Workspace’s menu has no Fields
- Fields back on, Goals’ Filters sheet has no Stage row
